mintAuthority.summary: SygFactory authorization resolves to code-empty platform-admin, role-manager, operator and system accounts. The native token upgrade delay is one second; factory replacement takes 86400 seconds.
mintAuthority.headline: Six privileged accounts can mint without an on-chain collateral cap; administrators can replace token logic after a one-second delay.

controls.label: FILQ-A permission-manager authority
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 26197100 (2026-10-15T09:45:11Z), https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com: getTokenInfo returns groups [1,12,13] and customGroupId=0. Full UserRoleAdded/Blacklisted/Reset and UserRolesReset replay from factory creation block 24878060 through this pin yields 24 events; current group bitmaps resolve four group1 OPERATOR and two group1 SYSTEM EOAs, enumerated below. No explicit MINTER_BURNER grant is present. Mint permission storage is 0xc0f under the two-bit role encoding, admitting roles 0, 1 and 5 but not PLATFORM_ADMIN role 3. Native-context canCall verifies six direct mint accounts and rejects the platform admin and both global role managers. Factory-context canCall verifies both role managers' updateMinterBurner permission and platform-admin upgradeToken permission. Token/factory implementation slots are unchanged; timelock storage reads remain 1/86400 seconds.

controls.label: FILQ-A platform-admin EOA
controls.evidence: Pinned group0/group1 bitmap 0x40 and getCode=0x identify platform administration. Native mint canCall is false for this account; factory-context canCall for upgradeToken(address,bytes) is true. It can replace native token logic through factory after the token's one-second delay. Factory replacement is separately 86400 seconds; financial/key-custody guarantees are not asserted.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197100 (2026-10-15T09:45:11Z), https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com, full factory role-event replay from creation block 24878060 and live group/code reads reconfirm groups [1,12,13], no custom group, four OPERATOR and two SYSTEM EOAs with native-context mint canCall=true. Mint permission storage remains 0xc0f under the two-bit role encoding. PLATFORM_ADMIN role 3 and both global role managers cannot directly mint; the role managers can authorize native mint through factory-context updateMinterBurner, and the platform admin can replace token logic through upgradeToken. Token/factory implementations remain unchanged and timelock delays remain 1/86400 seconds. Group1 pauser 0xb7cca0adbae4c9b51977688f2a75099d745f80b9 and group0-only SYSTEM 0x106ac3aa21c115eff3dfcd922a40393167d835b6 have neither native mint permission nor factory updateMinterBurner permission; their separate pause/user-administration roles are not additional native mint roots. Organizational identities, independence and MPC/HSM/signing policies of the nine mint/admin EOAs remain undisclosed. Current independent token-to-fund financial reconciliation and relief-qualifying whole-topology noninterference remain unestablished. Preserved historical regulator evidence: CIMA's official register was independently queried on 2026-10-04 and returned reference 2259655, Fidelity International Strategies Funds SPC, Mutual Fund - Registered, effective 10-Apr-2026, status ACT. This is the exact issuer acting for USD Digital Liquidity Fund SP and its FILQ Token share classes. The 14 September 2026 prospectus, printed pages 37-38, identifies Mutual Funds Act section 4(3) supervision, annual audited-account filings, Part 3B tokenised-fund issuance/ownership-record confirmations and CIMA technology-inspection and intervention powers; CIMA's July 2020 NAV rule requires a fair, complete, verifiable NAV policy for section 4 funds. These ongoing fund-governance, NAV and token-record obligations support prudential supervision of the issuing SPC, not a claim based on custodian regulation or an affiliated manager's licence. CIMA reference 2259655 is distinct from Cayman company-registration number 429148 (MC-429148); the October 4 regulator observation resolved the prospectus's conflicting future-tense registration wording. CIMA does not supervise investment activities or portfolio constitution, and the regime supplies neither a reserve guarantee nor recurring whole-token liabilities-to-backing evidence; reconciliation remains unknown.
